baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK / ARESETN asynchronous assert, synchronous release
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Two release stages clear asynchronously and shift ones on ACLK; local reset is low until the second release stage.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Reset release synchronization does not itself define RESET_WAIT arming or a sample qualification policy.

baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK destination domain; source reset is adc_src_clk-local; destination reset is AXI local_resetn
baseline_entries.producer: adc_sample_cdc_bridge destination-delivery interface and adc_sample_code_normalizer observational fork
baseline_entries.consumer: raw AXI protection top via dst_sample_valid/channels; normalizer debug outputs
baseline_entries.logic_kind: combinational wiring around registered CDC/normalizer blocks
baseline_entries.current_semantics: The accepted atomic raw CDC destination delivery drives the raw protection sample port. Normalized telemetry is a one-register parallel fork and is not connected to protection inputs.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: The current hierarchy has no episode or first-cause state and does not define how a reset-window sample qualifies arming.

baseline_entries.consumer: protection_core_top through the async AXI wrapper and Stage2E destination observer
baseline_entries.logic_kind: combinational enables, destination elastic register, atomic FIFO payload
baseline_entries.current_semantics: A source acceptance writes sequence plus both raw channels as one FIFO word. fifo_read_enable and u_fifo.rd_fire are internal FIFO prefetch events into destination_data. The later dst_sample_valid accepted edge is the atomic raw CDC destination delivery and the only Stage2B/Stage2G sample-event authority.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Closed: destination reset clears destination_valid, so a prefetched pre-reset word cannot deliver or replay after reset release.

baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: Separate write and read clock/reset domains
baseline_entries.producer: Gray pointer synchronizers and FIFO memory
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Full/empty are pointer-derived. Illegal write/read attempts are diagnostic pulses; no protection fault path consumes them.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: The FIFO has no semantic relationship to fault episodes; whether an integrity error blocks qualification must be frozen by policy.

baseline_entries.producer: sample_valid and raw channel inputs; current_compare_dual
baseline_entries.logic_kind: registered accepted pair and two-stage decision pipeline with combinational gates
baseline_entries.current_semantics: sample_accept_event is rst_n && sample_valid. Offset 0 captures the accepted destination-delivery pair, offset 1 snapshots comparator/health decisions, offset 2 registers classifier fault presence/code, and offset 3 lets the FSM consume that registered result. The pipeline accepts one transaction per ACLK.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Closed by the implementation companion: sequence, healthy completion valid, bitmap, code, and transaction integrity are aligned without changing the legacy module interface.

baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: Combinational in the protection clock data path
baseline_entries.producer: accepted raw pair and unsigned threshold registers
baseline_entries.consumer: protection_core_top decision snapshot and fault classifier
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Overcurrent and mismatch use strict unsigned greater-than comparisons; oc_any/or and oc_both/and are derived from channel causes.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: The current classifier collapses CH1 and CH2 overcurrent into one code; the target bitmap must retain channel identity without changing raw threshold semantics.

baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: Protection clk/rst_n; advances only when accepted_sample_valid is high
baseline_entries.producer: accepted raw pair and health thresholds
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Health counters saturate while conditions persist and reset on a safe accepted sample. Flags/events use registered prior counter values, then are consumed by the registered classifier.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Health flags are diagnostic/protection causes in the current classifier, but the current design does not expose the per-cause bitmap needed to preserve simultaneous health causes.

baseline_entries.producer: registered raw comparator and health event inputs
baseline_entries.logic_kind: registered outputs with combinational priority selection inside always block
baseline_entries.current_semantics: fault_valid is a registered nonzero fault-presence result for one evaluated transaction, not a general evaluation-valid pulse. Code priority is OC_WITH_SENSOR, OVERCURRENT, SENSOR_SATURATION, SENSOR_OPEN, SENSOR_STUCK, SENSOR_MISMATCH, NONE.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: The current interface has no completion valid for a healthy zero-bitmap result, no sequence identity, and no aligned primitive-cause bitmap or integrity result.

baseline_entries.consumer: fault_classifier, protection_fsm, testbenches, software-facing status documentation
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Seven 8-bit codes exist; there are no channel-specific overcurrent codes and no bitmap constants.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Stage 2G may use an internal bitmap while preserving these public code values; public field allocation is deferred to Stage 2H.

baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: Protection clk with asynchronous active-low rst_n
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Reset sets ST_NORMAL, not RESET_WAIT. ST_NORMAL clears latch/code each cycle and latches any fault. ST_FAULT_LATCHED unconditionally enters ST_RESET_WAIT on clear. ST_RESET_WAIT holds safe, gives fault_valid priority, and exits after RESET_WAIT_CYCLES fault-free clock opportunities regardless of sample activity.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: The implementation has no explicit armed state, episode marker, live-fault validity, clear rejection, first-cause guard, bitmap, or sample-qualified RESET_WAIT exit.

baseline_entries.current_semantics: Reset or disabled/zero-period operation drives pwm_raw low; otherwise the registered carrier follows the configured period and clamped duty.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: PWM raw generation has no knowledge of RESET_WAIT; safety depends entirely on pwm_disable and reset behavior.

baseline_entries.current_semantics: pwm_disable forces the configured disabled level; otherwise pwm_raw passes through.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: A registered FSM transition can make safe-state release and latch/code updates occur on adjacent edges; the target must require hold-through-qualified recovery.

baseline_entries.producer: AXI wrapper write strobes and register address
baseline_entries.consumer: protection_core_top, Stage2E status observer, AXI read response
baseline_entries.logic_kind: registered controls and combinational read mux
baseline_entries.current_semantics: CTRL[0] stores PWM enable; CTRL[1] produces a one-cycle clear pulse. Existing offsets 0x00 through 0x60 are fixed; Stage2E status uses W1C at 0x2C.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: There is no clear-acceptance or episode-status register; any new visibility must remain conceptual until Stage 2H.

baseline_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK with synchronized local_rst_n derived from ARESETN
baseline_entries.logic_kind: registered AXI FSM plus combinational ready/decode
baseline_entries.current_semantics: AXI state and downstream state reset asynchronously on local_rst_n; pending channel holds/responses are flushed. Register writes generate one-cycle internal pulses after a complete AW/W pair.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Closed for the protection path: reset flushes the bridge destination-valid state and all Stage2G pipeline valid bits before first post-reset eligibility.

baseline_entries.producer: ready/valid source behavior and FIFO overflow attempt
baseline_entries.consumer: Gray CDC buses and Stage2E destination observer
baseline_entries.logic_kind: registered monotonic counters and Gray mirrors
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Accepted source transactions increment sequence/counters; legal backpressure is separate from protocol violation; withdrawn/changed stalled payload is diagnostic.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: No current payload bit attaches stalled-offer stability to the accepted transaction; delayed Gray-synchronized counters cannot qualify that same transaction.

baseline_entries.producer: atomic destination-delivery sequence and synchronized source counters
baseline_entries.logic_kind: registered counters/status with combinational event decode
baseline_entries.current_semantics: Destination delivery quality errors are sticky/counted and W1C-cleared by cause; ANY_ERROR is maintained from causes and excludes legal backpressure.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: Closed for policy by the shared parameterized Stage 2E classification authority; sticky status, counters, underflow without delivery, and delayed source counters remain status-only.

baseline_entries.producer: atomic raw CDC destination delivery and generated Stage2F profile
baseline_entries.current_semantics: When profile_valid is true, raw delivery produces a normalized transaction one ACLK later; invalid/unconfigured profile produces no valid output. No normalizer output reaches classifier/FSM.
baseline_entries.known_ambiguity: A future implementation could accidentally gate arming or safe actuation on normalized_valid; the Stage 2G authority explicitly forbids that.

implementation_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK combinational classification in both Stage 2E and Stage 2G consumers
implementation_entries.producer: delivered FIFO sequence and each consumer's registered expected-sequence state
implementation_entries.consumer: Stage 2E destination counters and Stage 2G transaction-integrity eligibility
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: registered expected-sequence owners reset independently; classifier has no state
implementation_entries.visibility: Stage 2E counters/status and internal Stage 2G integrity field

implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: source acceptance before ACLK destination-delivery offset 0
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: clears offer history and restores clean default
implementation_entries.visibility: transaction-carried internal policy eligibility; counters remain diagnostic

implementation_entries.clock_reset_domain: adc_src_clk source domain to ACLK destination domain through async FIFO
implementation_entries.producer: stage2g_source_integrity_tracker and accepted raw source offer
implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: 0 at accepted ACLK destination delivery; internal FIFO prefetch is one ACLK earlier
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: source and destination local resets flush pointer state and delivery valid
implementation_entries.visibility: internal transaction metadata; no public port or AXI offset

implementation_entries.producer: registered raw comparator/health decision and aligned transaction metadata
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: clears valid and all aligned fields; no pre-reset retirement survives
implementation_entries.visibility: internal Stage 2G evaluation and MARK_DEBUG in production wrapper

implementation_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK with asynchronous active-low local reset
implementation_entries.producer: aligned fault evaluation and W1P clear request
implementation_entries.consumer: stage2g_protection_core internal episode/debug signals and safe-output gate
implementation_entries.logic_kind: registered episode FSM and request/evaluation clear fence
implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: 3 policy decision after accepted ACLK destination delivery
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: enters RESET_WAIT safe, clears episode fields and pending request
implementation_entries.visibility: internal episode fields and existing public compatibility outputs

implementation_entries.producer: atomic raw CDC destination delivery, shared sequence classification, evaluation pipeline, and episode controller
implementation_entries.logic_kind: registered pipeline integration and explicit internal/public episode boundary
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: flushes capture/decision valid stages and controller recovery state
implementation_entries.visibility: existing latch/code outputs carry compatibility state; recovery pending remains internal

implementation_entries.logic_kind: production integration wiring with unchanged register bank interface
implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: after policy decision; register read mux is combinational
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: downstream core and register bank reset from the same local reset
implementation_entries.visibility: STATUS and FAULT_CODE preserve existing offsets; pending is MARK_DEBUG only

implementation_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK with synchronized asynchronous-assert reset release
implementation_entries.consumer: software-visible AXI STATUS and FAULT_CODE reads
implementation_entries.logic_kind: registered AXI-Lite channel control around unchanged register map
implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: software readback after policy state is committed
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: flushes AXI requests/responses and resets downstream local state
implementation_entries.visibility: existing public offsets 0x04 STATUS and 0x08 FAULT_CODE

implementation_entries.clock_reset_domain: ACLK with asynchronous active-low local reset
implementation_entries.producer: episode start, legal clear acceptance, RESET_WAIT evaluation, ARMED transition, and reset
implementation_entries.consumer: stage2g_protection_core public outputs and existing register bank
implementation_entries.logic_kind: registered compatibility state distinct from internal episode lifetime
implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: 3 at policy decision; retained indefinitely without eligible evaluation
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: clears public latch/code and pending; RESET_WAIT remains safe
implementation_entries.visibility: public through existing STATUS.FAULT_LATCHED and FAULT_CODE; pending internal only

implementation_entries.clock_reset_domain: combinational output in the ACLK-controlled production path
implementation_entries.producer: stage2g_fault_episode_controller safe hold and pwm_gen raw carrier
implementation_entries.pipeline_offset: immediately reflects registered policy state after offset 3
implementation_entries.reset_behavior: controller asserts pwm_disable throughout reset and RESET_WAIT
implementation_entries.visibility: production pwm_out and simulation safety monitor
